_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your real values. config.json is gitignored and NEVER committed.
_db_path_comment: Leave null for the platform-safe application-data default (Windows LocalAppData, macOS Application Support, Linux XDG data). Never place live SQLite in OneDrive/Dropbox/source control.
_operations_timezone_comment: IANA timezone for the shared Monday-to-Sunday manual checklist. The server uses this calendar so every operator sees the same day and week even when their browser is in another timezone.
_inventory_comment: Auto-restock is opt-in. Keep false for alert-only ZERO_STOCK events (no Etsy PUT). Set true only when every automatic quantity increase is fulfillable. The Listings and Events tabs also expose an owner toggle (PATCH /api/inventory/auto-restock) that persists this flag without a restart. Requires listings_w OAuth scope.
_pre_transit_comment: pre_transit_days: upper bound (in days) for how long after label creation we query carrier tracking for an order. With the 4PX tracking integration active (Pass D in sync worker), this is NOT the primary pre-transit signal — carrier_confirmed_at IS NULL is. This value controls how far back we look for unconfirmed orders to check. 30 days is the default — it gives a generous window so even slow-moving packages are checked. Once carrier_confirmed_at is set (carrier physically picked up the package), the order immediately moves to In-transit regardless of this value.
_tracking_edit_comment: tracking_edit_days: window (in days) during which Etsy allows the tracking number of a shipped receipt to be edited / re-submitted. Etsy's policy is ~3 days from the shipment notification; after that their API rejects re-submitting tracking. The dashboard uses this value to show/hide the 'Edit tracking' action on pre-transit orders and to display the remaining time. Etsy remains the source of truth — a call outside the window still surfaces Etsy's own rejection.
_recently_packaged_comment: recently_packaged_days: legacy look-back hint (no longer caps the Recently packaged list — full packing history is shown with day chips + an archive picker). Kept for API compatibility; safe to omit.
_require_verify_comment: require_verify_before_pack: two-person integrity gate. When true, an order must be packer-VERIFIED (items physically confirmed in hand via the 'Verify purchases' worklist) — not merely shopper-marked 'Purchased' — before it enters the 'To pack & ship' queue. Leave false (default) for a single-operator shop where the same person shops and packs (no behavior change). Set true when a separate shopper and packer create a useful check-in step.
_fourpx_comment: 4PX Official Open Platform API credentials (https://open.4px.com). When set, the sync worker uses the authenticated tr.order.tracking.get endpoint to determine precise pre-transit/in-transit status for 4PX shipments. These credentials ALSO power the 'Create 4PX Shipment' feature in the Orders tab. Register at https://open.4px.com to obtain these values.
_fourpx_tracking_comment: Independent parcel tracking refresh. The dashboard server owns the scheduler and wakes every fourpx_tracking_interval_minutes, but only checks due parcels: inside the hot window, pre-transit every 2h and moving/exception parcels every 6h; older open parcels remain on a low-frequency long-tail check until 4PX reports a terminal state or an operator archives them. Failed checks retry exponentially from 15m to 120m. Requests are serial, paced, capped per run and protected by a cross-process lock. Set fourpx_tracking_sync=false to disable automatic carrier polling; per-row manual refresh remains available. For a headless sync-worker deployment with no dashboard server, set FOURPX_TRACKING_WORKER=1 in that worker's environment.
_fourpx_order_comment: 4PX shipping order creation settings. These three fields enable the 'Create 4PX Shipment' button on unshipped orders. fourpx_sender: your registered shipper address — must match the address registered with your 4PX account. REQUIRED fields: first_name, country, city, post_code. IMPORTANT: post_code (sender ZIP/postal code) is required for ALL destinations — 4PX rejects orders without it with error DS000000. Australia, Canada, NZ, US, and GB also require phone. fourpx_warehouse_code: the 4PX warehouse/drop-off code (e.g. 'CNSZX01' for Shenzhen SZX — ask your 4PX account manager). fourpx_default_product: fallback logistics product when POSTLINK-S5058 (S5058 / postlink-s5058) is not offered for the destination (e.g. 'QC'). The dashboard always prefers POSTLINK-S5058 when the destination catalogue lists it. Leave fourpx_sender null to disable shipment creation.
_fourpx_pickup_comment: 4PX door-to-door pickup booking (揽收预约 / 新建预约). Lets the packing bench book a 4PX driver for the parcels it just sealed, from the Orders tab, instead of logging into b.4px.com. Uses ds.xms.api.collect.create.order (book) / .cancel.order (cancel) / .print.order (appointment-form PDF); these must be enabled on your 4PX Open Platform app — ask your account manager if booking returns a permission error. fourpx_pickup is the DEFAULT COLLECTION ADDRESS the driver comes to, which is NOT the same thing as fourpx_sender (the shipper printed on the label): required name, phone, country, province, city, district, detail_address; optional street, zip_code. It only PRE-FILLS the booking dialog, so an incomplete block warns at startup instead of failing — the packer completes it on screen. Aliases (contact_name, mobile, address, zip, …) are accepted. fourpx_pickup_booking: false hides the feature. fourpx_pickup_timezone: the IANA zone the pickup CALENDAR is read in — 4PX interprets the booked date as a local date at the pickup address, so leave this on the pickup city's zone even if the dashboard machine is elsewhere. fourpx_pickup_max_days_ahead: how many days the date picker offers, including today (default 14, max 60). fourpx_pickup_awaiting_days: how recently a parcel must have been sealed to count as still waiting for a driver (default 7, max 90) — a parcel 4PX never scanned but which left weeks ago is a tracking problem, not a pickup, and counting those would make the pickup bar's number meaningless. NOTE: 4PX publishes no 'query appointment' API, so driver assignment and collection progress (已分配 / 已揽收 / 已交仓) are only visible in the 4PX portal; the dashboard shows what it submitted.
_multi_key_approval_comment: Etsy API Terms assign one designated key per application. Keep false unless Etsy approved this exact multi-key/shop topology in writing and you retained that response. This flag records approval; it does not create permission.
_catalog_health_comment: Growth is manual-first and makes zero Etsy API calls. Leave both values false and paste aggregate Etsy Shop Manager Stats into Growth. Etsy's API Terms (updated Aug 18, 2026) require express written authorization to request API content for analytics. Set etsy_api_analytics_approved true only after receiving and retaining that written authorization; catalog_health_sync additionally opts into the once-per-shop listing/review walk. Both true values are required. catalog_health_interval_hours is clamped to 12–168.
_fourpx_freight_comment: 4PX shipping-cost sync (shown in the Earnings tab). When 4PX credentials are set, the sync worker prices every 4PX order: an immediate rate-card ESTIMATE via ds.xms.estimated_cost.get (the cost the 4PX portal shows once a parcel is measured), reconciled to the BILLED amount via ds.xms.order.getFreight once 4PX settles it. fourpx_freight_sync: set false to disable the extra API traffic. fourpx_freight_recheck_hours: how often an unbilled/estimated order is re-priced (default 6). fourpx_default_weight_g: fallback parcel weight (grams) for orders with no stored declared weight (default 100). fourpx_settlement_currency: currency 4PX bills in (CN accounts: CNY).
_fourpx_stuck_comment: Shipping tab: a 4PX parcel with no acceptance/progress scan for this many days is flagged as 'stuck' while upstream. Destination-network and last-mile parcels receive a longer grace period. Explicit 4PX exception/disposal codes take effect immediately. Default 10.
_label_print_comment: Shipping-label printing. The 'Print label' button rasterizes the 4PX label PDF to a pure 1-bit bitmap at the printer's exact native resolution and prints it 1:1, keeping the barcode crisp/scannable (normal scaled printing blurs the bars into grey). label_print_mode: 'auto' = silent direct print on Windows when label_printer_name is installed, otherwise open the PDF in your default app; 'silent' = always direct print; 'open' = always open the PDF. label_printer_name: exact Windows printer name. label_width_mm/label_height_mm: the label stock PHYSICALLY LOADED in the printer. 4PX labels are square (94 x 94 mm artwork), so square stock prints them full-size; on non-square stock the label is letterboxed to the shorter side (80 x 60 stock => a 60 mm square with blank side margins and a 25% smaller barcode). The server logs a warning and returns coverage_pct < 100 whenever the configured media does not match the label's shape. label_dpi: print-head resolution (Deli DL-720W = 203). label_print_threshold: 1-255 black/white cutoff (higher = bolder). label_print_copies: copies per click.
_pickup_form_print_comment: The 4PX pickup appointment form (打印预约单) prints through the SAME settings as a shipping label, from the same button pipeline: 4PX issues it as a 95 x 95 mm square whose content is a barcode of the appointment number — a label, not an office document — so it goes on the same stock, at label_dpi, through the same 1-bit crisp-barcode path. There is deliberately nothing extra to configure. If 4PX ever returns a form that is NOT label-shaped, the server refuses to shrink it onto label stock and opens the PDF instead.
_fourpx_ioss_comment: EU VAT compliance. fourpx_ioss_no: your Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) registration number — REQUIRED by 4PX for EU (EU27) destinations with a declared value <= EUR 150 (field 'ioss_no'). For marketplace sales (e.g. Etsy) use the platform's IOSS number. Format: 'IM' + 10 digits (12 chars, no spaces, no 'IOSS' prefix). The server attaches it automatically to every EU27 order. fourpx_vat_no / fourpx_eori_no: optional EU VAT / EORI identifiers, attached to EU orders when set. Leave null to omit.
_marketplace_tax_ids_comment: Import-tax identifiers Etsy registers per destination, shown on the packing bench and transmitted as customs data. src/compliance/destination-tax.js ships a reviewed value for every scheme, so leave this null unless Etsy changes a number or you sell through another marketplace. Keys: EU_IOSS, UK_VAT, NO_VOEC, CH_VAT, AU_GST, NZ_GST — e.g. { "UK_VAT": "370 6004 28" }. Values are format- and checksum-validated at load; an invalid entry is ignored with a warning and the built-in value is used. NOTE: Etsy forbids writing the EU IOSS number on a parcel (it must be transmitted electronically); the UK VAT number is the opposite — Etsy instructs you to write it on the package.
_fourpx_email_comment: Default recipient email injected when the buyer's Etsy email is unavailable. 4PX requires recipient_info.email for all Etsy-origin shipments (and mandates it for MX, etc.). Set this to your shop contact address as a safe fallback.
_route_engine_comment: Self-contained Shopping Route generator. route_engine_dir overrides the vendored code location. route_engine_data_dir optionally moves mutable catalog SQLite/workbook/images outside OneDrive while keeping code vendored; run npm run relocate-route-data with the dashboard stopped. osp_python selects Python. osp_output_dir controls generated workbooks. osp_project_dir is a deprecated legacy fallback.
_auth_note: OAuth access tokens expire in 1 HOUR. Run npm run oauth:setup so refresh tokens are written atomically to gitignored tokens.json; leave per-shop refresh_token null unless you deliberately need the legacy fallback. Re-authorize when Etsy expires or revokes a refresh token.
_compliance_note: Etsy API safety: connect only shops and the single designated API key Etsy approved for this application's declared purpose. Never create duplicate apps/keys to bypass limits; a multi-key topology requires written Etsy approval. Platform shop/key allocations have no local override. Keep auto_restock_enabled false unless physical inventory is authoritative. Keep sync_interval_minutes >= 15 and inv_watch_interval_minutes >= 60. Run npm run compliance:check.
_email_imap_comment: OPTIONAL — per-shop email_imap block enables the Messages tab email sync feature. Etsy sends a notification email to the shop's linked Gmail/Outlook account whenever a buyer sends a message. This dashboard polls that inbox via IMAP, parses the emails, and displays the conversations here. GMAIL SETUP: (1) Enable 2-Step Verification on the Google account. (2) Go to Google Account → Security → App Passwords. (3) Choose 'Mail' and generate a 16-character app password. (4) Use that code as `password` — NOT your regular Gmail login. OUTLOOK: use your regular password or an app password if MFA is enabled. Leave out the email_imap block entirely to skip email sync for that shop.

groups._compliance: This is one operational network group within one Etsy-approved application. Add shops only within the allocation shown in the Developer Portal. Do not add another API key unless Etsy approves this application using it in writing.
groups.label: Operations Group 1

shops._note_api_key: Find keystring in Etsy > Manage Apps. x-api-key header = keystring:shared_secret (both required per Etsy API docs)
shops._note_refresh_token: Complete OAuth via npm run oauth:setup; tokens are saved in tokens.json. Keep this null unless using the legacy config fallback.
